verdict.rationale: Relay documents syncing transaction data into QuickBooks Online and Xero (relay-docs-19) and categorizing expenses in real time (relay-docs-3), which reduces manual entry, but this is one-way transaction sync into small-business accounting software, not bidirectional sync with an ERP system replacing journal entries. Missing for 10: evidence of true ERP (e.g., NetSuite/SAP) integration, bidirectional sync (journal entries flowing back), and any independent confirmation of 'real-time' accuracy beyond marketing copy.
